Question: What is the average loss of each policy by policy number where loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(cp.Total_Loss) AS Average_Loss
FROM (
    SELECT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    INNER JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    INNER JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Loss_Payment lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Loss_Reserve lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Expense_Payment ep
        WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Expense_Reserve er
        WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
) cp
INNER JOIN Policy p
    ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number;

What is the premium amount of all policies by policy number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number;

Question: What is the premium amount of all policies by policy number?
What is the premium amount of all policies by policy number, coverage effective date and coverage expiration date
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date AS Coverage_Expiration_Date,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
FROM Policy p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Premium pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date,
    pcd.Expiration_Date;

    p.Policy_Identifier,

    c.Company_Subclaim_Number,
    c.Claim_Description,

    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,

    cat.Catastrophe_Type_Code,
    cat.Industry_Catastrophe_Code,
    cat.Company_Catastrophe_Code
FROM Policy p

JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c

    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
